1.w: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, every one who is judging. For in that which you judge the other, you are condemning yourself, for you, the one judging, practice the same things.

2.w: But we know that the judgment of God upon those practicing such things is according to truth.

3.w: Now do you reckon this, O man, the one judging those practicing such things, and doing them [yourself], that you will escape the judgment of God?

4.w: Or do you despise the riches of His kindness and forbearance and patience, not knowing that the kindness of God leads you to repentance?

5.w: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart, you are storing up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God,

6.w: who “will repay to each according to his works,”

7.w: to those who indeed with perseverance in good work are seeking glory and honor and immortality, eternal life;

8.w: but to those of self-interest and disobeying the truth but obeying unrighteousness, wrath and anger;

9.w: tribulation and distress upon every soul of man working evil, both of Jew first, and also of Greek;

10.w: but glory and honor and peace to everyone working good, both to Jew first, and to Greek.

11.w: For there is no partiality with God.

12.w: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law; and as many as have sinned in the law will be judged by the law,

13.w: for not the hearers of the law [are] righteous before God; but the doers of the law will be declared righteous.

14.w: For when Gentiles, not having the law, may do by nature the things of the law, these not having a law are a law to themselves,

15.w: who show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also testifying, and the thoughts between one another accusing or also defending [them]

16.w: on the day when God judges the secrets of men according to my gospel through Christ Jesus.

17.w: But if you are named a Jew and rest upon the law and boast in God,

18.w: and you know the will and approve the [things] being superior, being instructed out of the law,

19.w: and you have persuaded yourself [that you] are a guide of the blind, a light to those in darkness,

20.w: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of infants, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth—

21.w: then [you] who are teaching another, do you not teach yourself? [You] who are preaching not to steal, do you steal?

22.w: [You] who are saying not to commit adultery, do you commit adultery? [You] who are abhorring idols, do you rob temples?

23.w: [You] who boast in the law, do you dishonor God through the transgression of the law?

24.w: As it has been written: “For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you⁺.”

25.w: For circumcision indeed profits if you practice the law; but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

26.w: Therefore if the uncircumcision keeps the righteous requirements of the law, will not his uncircumcision be reckoned as circumcision?

27.w: And the uncircumcision by nature, fulfilling the law, will judge you who through the letter and circumcision [are] a transgressor of the law.

28.w: For [it is] not the one [who] on the outside is a Jew, nor [is] [that] on the outside in flesh circumcision.

29.w: But a Jew [is one] on the inside, and circumcision [is] of heart, in spirit, not in letter, of whom the praise [is] not of men, but of God.
